label: Bible Study
prompt: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of _____ that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
verse: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
note: Faith tested like gold in a furnace — and worth far more than gold.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The _____ of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
verse: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
note: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD — and He delights in the walk.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the third day there was a _____ in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
verse: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
note: Jesus' first miracle happened at a wedding in Cana — the KJV calls it a marriage, and the wine was about to run out.

label: Deep Water
prompt: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and _____, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verse: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
note: Jude ends his warnings with one of Scripture's grandest doxologies — the last word belongs to praise.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Lord, now _____ thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verse: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
note: Old Simeon, holding the baby Jesus in the temple: now 'lettest thou thy servant depart in peace.'
